name: vgroup
description: Mark files and folders with markers to keep semantically related items side by side, regardless of alphabetical order.

vgroup.map.columnWidth.description: Width in pixels of the map column opened beside the Explorer (VGroup: Toggle Map Column Beside Explorer).

vgroup.showDecorations.description: Show marker badges and colors in the standard Explorer.

scripts.package: npm run generate:colors && npm run typecheck && node esbuild.js --production && mkdir -p version && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out version/
